styles: micro-edited percussion made from mechanical keyboard clicks
loud and dense from the start

chunks.name: Hook
styles: kick and sub bass from the first beat
chunks.text: {full beat starts immediately on beat 1 at full volume: kick, sub bass and glitch click percussion together, no intro, no fade in}

chunks.name: Build
chunks.text: {groove keeps driving at full volume, rolling bass, crisp hats added}

chunks.name: Lift
chunks.text: {same full groove, adds offbeat glassy pluck chops, energy lifts}

chunks.name: Groove
chunks.text: {full groove, short glitch stutter fill every two bars}

chunks.name: Stutter break
chunks.text: {kick and bass stop, only a stutter-gated pluck with the filter closing, tension}

chunks.name: Drop
chunks.text: {full drop hits on beat 1, heaviest kick and sub of the track, bitcrushed glitch lead}

chunks.name: Rise
chunks.text: {snare and glitch roll building, filter rising, last half bar stops}

chunks.name: Button
chunks.text: {one big unison hit with sub on beat 1, then let it ring out, no more drums}
